title: Adam and AdamW from scratch

paper.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Adam and AdamW from scratch: implement biased moments bias correction epsilon placement and decoupled AdamW decay; match torch updates. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use optimizer-fixture; required output: Optimizer adapter over parameter tensors; wrap state in a torch module. Evaluate update_max_error (minimize). Match torch Adam and AdamW step by step including bias correction epsilon and weight decay. Required ablation: Compare coupled L2 penalty with decoupled decay using the same gradients. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
